name: HC-SR04 ultrasonic distance sensor
description: Measures distance 2-400 cm with ultrasound. 5 V part with a 5 V echo output.
notes: Classic HC-SR04 needs 5 V. ECHO is a 5 V signal: shift it down for ESP32 / Pico (level shifter or 1 k + 2.2 k divider).
Newer versions (RCWL-9610 chip, sometimes sold as HC-SR04P) work from 3-5.5 V and then echo at the supply voltage. Check the chip and the listing.
Do not trigger more often than every 60 ms.

pins.name: TRIG
pins.label: Trig
pins.note: 10 us HIGH pulse starts a measurement. 3.3 V logic usually triggers it (confirm on your board).

pins.name: ECHO
pins.label: Echo
pins.note: Outputs 5 V pulses: needs a level shifter or divider (e.g. 1 k / 2.2 k) before a 3.3 V GPIO.

geometry.note: Board 45 x 20 mm, two 16 mm transducers 26 mm apart (centres). Holes approximate.
